title: ActorProf: A Framework for Profiling and Visualizing Fine-grained Asynchronous Bulk Synchronous Parallel Execution
problem: Existing profilers (Score-P, TAU, CrayPat, Intel VTune, HPCToolkit) cannot effectively profile FA-BSP programs because these applications rely on multiple external libraries and require frequent runtime switches between program portions. This makes it difficult to profile message-passing behavior and visualize results in an FA-BSP-aware manner.
motivation: Large irregular applications using the FA-BSP model demonstrate promising performance but lack profiling tools designed to understand their asynchronous execution characteristics.
method: ActorProf instruments FA-BSP programs with hardware performance counters to track asynchronous point-to-point messages and automatic message aggregation, provides overall performance breakdown aware of FA-BSP synchronization barriers and execution phases, and visualizes profiling results in an intuitive manner tailored to FA-BSP program structure.
key_novelty: First profiling framework specifically designed for FA-BSP execution that provides message-aware profiling with hardware counters and FA-BSP-aware performance breakdown.
contributions: Asynchronous point-to-point message-aware profiling with hardware performance counter integration
Performance breakdown mechanism specific to FA-BSP execution model and synchronization patterns
Intuitive visualization of FA-BSP profiling results
ActorProf framework implementation and case studies

metrics.other: message latency analysis, profiling overhead, visualization accuracy
